summary: Two day hikers (Mt. Crested Butte mayor William Buck and Tom Filchner) overdue from a Poverty Gulch/Purple Mountain day hike; SAR search launched 5:30 a.m. Monday after a planned Monday-night entry; pair phoned from Oh Be Joyful Pass after noon, uninjured after a 19-hour benighted hike.
location: Purple Mountain / Poverty Gulch / Oh Be Joyful Pass
notes: Hike began Sunday 2010-09-12; mission date is the 2010-09-13 search. Pair bivouacked by a fire in Swan Basin after crossing Angel Pass off-plan; Civil Air Patrol and Western State SAR were being mobilized when the call came in.
